content.short: Owlto Finance is a decentralized cross-rollup bridge focused on L2 networks, providing fast and low-cost asset transfers to Mantle.
content.description: Owlto Finance is a decentralized bridge specifically optimized for Layer 2 networks, achieving significantly lower fees than general-purpose bridges by focusing on L2-to-L2 and L1-to-L2 transfer routes. The protocol is deployed on Mantle and supports major L2 networks, making it a go-to solution for efficiently moving assets into and within the Mantle L2 ecosystem without the higher fees of mainnet bridge alternatives.
content.meta: Owlto Finance is a fast, low-cost cross-rollup bridge for L2 networks including Mantle. Discover Owlto Finance on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
